title: UK Public Library Policy Archive — Provenance and Fixity Schema
description: Validates PREMIS-aligned preservation, acquisition, fixity, and conversion provenance records (provenance.yaml).

source_url.description: Canonical publication landing page URL from which the document was identified.

source_pdf_url.description: Direct URL(s) from which the source PDF file(s) were downloaded.

acquired_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which the source document was acquired into the archive.

accessed_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which the source URL was last accessed and verified.

source_checksum.description: Cryptographic checksum(s) of the source file(s) (typically prefixed as sha256:<64-hex-chars>).

pdf_sha256.description: 64-character lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 hash(es) of the preserved PDF(s) in source/.

download_method.description: Tool or procedure used to retrieve the source binary (e.g., curl, wget, browser-direct, ukgwa-capture, synthetic-born-digital).

conversion_method.description: Method used to create the diplomatic Markdown edition (e.g., manual, pdf-text-extraction-with-manual-verification, ocr-with-manual-review).

conversion_date.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) on which the Markdown edition was generated.

review_status.description: Editorial review status of the diplomatic Markdown transcription.
